events.title: Harun al-Rashid becomes Abbasid caliph
events.description: On the night his brother al-Hadi died, Harun al-Rashid became caliph in Baghdad. His reign, remembered through the Thousand and One Nights, marked a high point of Abbasid power and culture.
events.html: On the night his brother al-Hadi died, Harun al-Rashid became caliph in Baghdad. His reign, remembered through the Thousand and One Nights, marked a high point of Abbasid power and culture.

events.title: Dante Alighieri dies in exile in Ravenna
events.description: Dante died in Ravenna, months after finishing the Divine Comedy. Written in Tuscan rather than Latin, his poem helped make that dialect the basis of the Italian language.
events.html: Dante died in Ravenna, months after finishing the Divine Comedy. Written in Tuscan rather than Latin, his poem helped make that dialect the basis of the Italian language.

events.title: Napoleon's army enters Moscow
events.description: The Grande Armée entered a largely deserted Moscow, and fires soon destroyed much of the city. Napoleon waited five weeks for a peace offer that never came before beginning his disastrous retreat.

events.title: McKinley dies and Theodore Roosevelt becomes president
events.description: William McKinley died of gangrene from his gunshot wounds. Theodore Roosevelt, aged 42, became the youngest president in US history.
events.html: William McKinley died of gangrene from his gunshot wounds. Theodore Roosevelt, aged 42, became the youngest president in US history.

events.title: Princess Grace of Monaco dies after a car crash
events.description: Former film star Grace Kelly died a day after her car left a mountain road above Monaco. She had given up Hollywood to marry Prince Rainier III in 1956.
